true_answer: 74 1. Counting what path we take, we must make three steps right and two steps up. No matter what order we make these steps, there will always be 5 steps. Thus each path has length 5. The counting question: how many lattice paths are there between ( 0 , 0 ) and ( 3 , 2 ) ? We could try to draw all of these, or instead of drawing them, maybe just list which direction we travel on each of the 5 steps. One path might be RRUUR, or maybe UURRR, or perhaps RURRU (those correspond to the three paths drawn above). So how many such strings of R’s and U’s are there?
